body.en: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/compressed-air-pipe-pressure-d_36.html electric 80 vs HBT8018 concrete pump Electric 80 vs HBT8018 Concrete Pump Both list 60 m³/h and 40 MPa. Motor, distance layout, aggregate and weight are different cells. Electric 80 and HBT8018 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 80 lists 110 kW, distance 900 m / 300 m and aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). HBT8018 lists 132 kW, model HBT8018-132S, conveying distance 150 m, delivery height 450 m and aggregate 4 cm and below. Same output does not mean the same reach cell. Where Electric 80 and HBT8018 list different values Model line: Electric 80 lists Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110; HBT8018 lists HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. Motor power: Electric 80 lists 110 kW; HBT8018 lists 132 kW. Max. aggregate size: Electric 80 lists 24 mm (≤ 2 cm); HBT8018 lists 4 cm and below. Dimensions: Electric 80 lists 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm; HBT8018 lists 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm. The same listed value on a shared label: Theoretical output is 60 m³/h on both pages. These are listed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Cells that exist on only one of these pumps Electric 80 lists cells that HBT8018 does not: Max. outlet pressure 40 MPa; Hopper capacity 0.7 m³; Pumping distance (H / V) 900 m / 300 m; Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 140 double pump; Main unit weight 6000 kg. HBT8018 lists cells that Electric 80 does not: Pumping pressure 40 MPa; Conveying distance 150 m; Delivery height 450 m; Delivery pipe diameter 100 / 125 mm; Total weight 6500 kg. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. How to read the two pages without merging them HBT8018 writes distance and height as two labels. Electric 80 writes one H / V pair. Open /en/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/ for Electric 80 and /en/products/hbt8018-concrete-pump/ for HBT8018. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price. Does Electric 80 list the same model line as HBT8018? No. Electric 80 lists Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110. HBT8018 lists HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other. Does Electric 80 list the same motor power as HBT8018? No. Electric 80 lists 110 kW. HBT8018 lists 132 kW. Does Electric 80 list the same max. aggregate size as HBT8018? No. Electric 80 lists 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). HBT8018 lists 4 cm and below. Why is max. outlet pressure missing on HBT8018? The HBT8018 page does not list that label. Electric 80 lists 40 MPa. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. 电动80和HBT8018混凝土泵有何不同
两边都印 60 m³/h 和 40 MPa。
电机、距离写法、骨料和重量不是同一格。
电动80和 HBT8018 是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。
电动80印 110 kW、距离 900 m / 300 m、骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。
HBT8018 印 132 kW、型号 HBT8018-132S、输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下。
产量相同不等于距离格相同。
电动80和HBT8018哪些数值不同
型号行：电动80印 Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110；HBT8018印 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S。
电机功率：电动80印 110 kW；HBT8018印 132 kW。
最大骨料粒径：电动80印 24 mm (≤ 2 cm)；HBT8018印 4 cm and below。
外形尺寸：电动80印 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm；HBT8018印 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm。
同一标题下数值相同的有：理论输送量两边都是 60 m³/h。
以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。
只在其中一台泵上出现的格子
电动80有、HBT8018没有的行：最大出口压力 40 MPa；料斗容积 0.7 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直） 900 m / 300 m；液压泵 Kawasaki 140 double pump；整机重量 6000 kg。
HBT8018有、电动80没有的行：泵送压力 40 MPa；输送距离 150 m；输送高度 450 m；输送管内径 100 / 125 mm；整机重量 6500 kg。
缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。
怎样分开阅读这两个页面
HBT8018 把距离和高度分成两个标题。
电动80写成一组水平/垂直。
看电动80请打开 /zh/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/，看HBT8018请打开 /zh/products/hbt8018-concrete-pump/。
河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。
商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。
如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。
电动80和HBT8018的型号行一样吗？
不一样。
电动80印 Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110。
HBT8018印 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S。
两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。
电动80和HBT8018的电机功率一样吗？
电动80印 110 kW。
HBT8018印 132 kW。
电动80和HBT8018的最大骨料粒径一样吗？
电动80印 24 mm (≤ 2 cm)。
HBT8018印 4 cm and below。
为什么HBT8018没有最大出口压力？
HBT8018这一页没有印这个标题。
电动80印的是 40 MPa。
缺的格子保持空白。

question.en: Does Electric 80 list the same model line as HBT8018?
question.zh: 电动80和HBT8018的型号行一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 lists Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110. HBT8018 lists HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
